description:
List queued and sent events for your endpoints, newest first among those read, with each delivery’s status. There is no next page, and with many stored deliveries the newest may be missing: narrow with endpointId, eventType or status.
Use for: checking queued and sent events, and finding deliveries that failed.
Not for: reading one delivery with its body and tries (get_webhook_delivery); seeing your endpoints (list_webhook_endpoints).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_webhook_deliveries({"endpointId":"Wk3pQ8vN1sXr6TzL0aBc","status":"delivered","limit":20})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

endpointId.description: Only deliveries to this endpoint. An id that is not yours gives an empty list.

eventType.description: Only deliveries of this event type. Leave out for all event types.

limit.description: Most deliveries wanted. There is no next page.

status.description: pending: waiting to be sent. claimed: being sent now. delivered: your URL answered 2xx. retry: it failed and will be sent again. failed: no more tries.

name: list_webhook_deliveries

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

deliveredAt.description: When your URL accepted it. Left out until then.

eventId.description: The id of the event. A resent event keeps its id.

failedAt.description: When the last try failed for good. Left out until then.

id.description: The delivery id to call get_webhook_delivery with.

lastError.description: Why the last try failed. Left out when none failed.

responseStatus.description: HTTP status your URL gave on the last try. Left out before the first answer.

status.description: pending: waiting to be sent. claimed: being sent now. delivered: your URL answered 2xx. retry: it failed and will be sent again. failed: no more tries.

title: List webhook deliveries
